reason: Flanigan's runs casual restaurants/sports bars and package liquor stores in South Florida, earning from food and drink sales to local diners. MSG Entertainment is a live entertainment venue and show business (arenas, theaters, the Rockettes show) earning from tickets, venue licensing and sponsorship. Its nightlife and restaurant arm (Tao Group Hospitality) was agreed to be sold, so the one overlapping line is leaving. Only food and beverage sold at venues remains, and that is incidental.
reason_if_0: Different business model: MSG is a ticketed live-event venue and production company, not a restaurant or liquor retailer. Its restaurant and nightlife business is being divested.
